scope: Windows native held-child and whole-Job composition premises on x64 and ARM64; not production WindowsAttempt acceptance

task_contract.objective: Bounded Windows held-root/gated-child composition readiness, two-manager attribution, root-exit versus whole-Job barrier and observed CRT image semantics
task_contract.other_agents: No other worker or source was commanded or modified. Allocation producer and startup accepted receipts reused; WindowsAttempt prerequisite diagnostic remains owned by finish_completion_free_retry.

outcome.processes_per_attempt: one root and one genuinely gated child

reused_evidence.reuse: Current allocation resource and Frida startup accepted on both architectures; no standalone startup, residency, streams, host mapping or allocation-component suite repeated. Native composition necessarily invokes those unchanged owners.
reused_evidence.dependency_recipe: Accepted URL/SHA256 manifest reused; remote downloads validated before use. JDK 27.0.1 exact x64/ARM64 ZIP checksums retained in setup.sh. Frida 17.24.3 devkit and static library SHA match accepted recipes; newly linked DLL hashes are explicitly recorded, not claimed identical to prior timestamped binaries.

held_root_plus_accepted_hook_readiness.evidence: Four cases per architecture, two simultaneous independent attempts per case; root sentinel false before release, accepted root hook ready first.

genuinely_gated_child_sentinel_order.evidence: Each child sentinel false before child attachment and after accepted AllocationHook readiness; assertion immediately before native manager.resume also false. Sentinel true after explicit resume. Compiled source, actual class bytes, raw events/receipts and sentinel files retained.

exact_owned_Job_attribution_two_managers.evidence: Every copied child PID verified through WindowsProcess.openMember and requireLive against its exact Job; the other owned Job rejected it. Retained original root PID matched event parent. In these cases each manager delivered only its own child event; no cross-manager duplicate observed. This observation is not a global promise against duplicates; adapter must verify containment and deduplicate identity.

root_exit_child_survival_whole_job_barri.evidence: Root process liveness false, child process live, sentinel present and WindowsProcess.poll empty. Releasing child produced actual Job-empty/root-signaled Result, cached before hook/session/manager cleanup. Natural root status 23 for CreateProcess and 0 for CRT exec; aborted false. Child status 37 is fixture behavior, not a descendant status reported by WindowsProcess.Result.

CRT_exec_image_semantics.evidence: _wexecv produced a distinct child PID and Frida origin SPAWN=2, with root exit 0. No same-PID EXEC=1 event observed. Same retained-identity/ready/resume/barrier sequence passed.
CRT_exec_image_semantics.limit: No general claim that Windows can never replace an image in place. Unexpected EXEC or unsupported origin remains fail-closed; no image-only disposal authority is introduced.

fresh_changed_probe_gate.evidence: Java driver and native sentinel fixture rebuilt into initially absent classes-fresh and fresh-fixture directories on the same retained workers. Both native paths then passed in fresh output directories. Two driver classes identical between incremental and fresh, across both architectures. Accepted producer and production owners were reused.

native_and_remote_terminal_cleanup.evidence: All native attempts and Frida runtimes closed after actual Job barriers; later owned executable inventory zero. Both owned remote roots removed and absence checked. Final explicit shell exits and SSH clients returned 0. Provider post-Upterm/storage and incremental-state cleanup succeeded; original deliberate workflow exit17 retained as job failure. Local keys removed after all final users ended.

commands_and_results.dispatch: Existing runner-debug-smoke.yml on main.new at accepted snapshot, one fresh key and one owned free runner per target. No workflow edit. Workflow limits: 60 minutes, Upterm v0.40.0, default unjoined/idle limit30 minutes, existing sole-key authorization and pinned CA reused.
commands_and_results.local_compile: JDK27 javac --release27 against exact accepted package and dependency bytes; exit0. Actual command/output retained in local/compile.json. This checks Java compilation, not Windows native behavior.
commands_and_results.native_launch: run.sh and fresh.sh retain exact named-module/patch-module launches; only com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling receives --enable-native-access. Requirements API assertions run through accepted dependency manifest. No ALL-UNNAMED native-access grant.
commands_and_results.verification: python3 verify-native.py: exit0; checks both archives closure, member sizes/SHA, all actual case receipts and ordering, original statuses, incremental/fresh class equality, exact packaged JAR and resource. No native test rerun during verification.

retained_failures.detail: A guessed action implementation path did not exist; the action.yml named session.cjs and that declared file was read. Initial uploader source had a Python string quoting SyntaxError; corrected and syntax-checked before transfers. No production/native behavior changed.

Both exact bundle SHA values matched, but Git Bash tar treated C:/D: archive path as remote-host syntax (exit128). Retained transferred bytes; changed only extraction invocation to cd into the same root and use relative archive path, then setup passed. Failed response1031 and recovery response1032 retained.

Initial plain ANSI stripping left repeated terminal-overstrike characters and base64 padding failed. Exact raw bytes retained. Removed only repeated base64 character at CRLF+CSI23;80H same-column redraw boundary, then strict base64 decoded and exact worker SHA matched. Overstrike counts9434 x64/9200 ARM64; raw archives validated member-by-member. Original-retrieval-recovery.json records method and SHA.

Both original SSH clients recorded Broken pipe/exit255 after completed collection request1062. Queued alternate retrieval1063 was never sent; local cancellation status125 explicitly has remote_exit=null, not a manufactured remote result. No native commands/tests were rerun.

Upterm replayed prompt used CSI1C cursor motion after # rather than a literal space, so old detector did not admit queued commands. Controlled client interrupts130, no remote commands sent. Detector accepted a line-ending root/user prompt after ANSI stripping; reconnect retained-state command1064 and cleanup1065 passed. Keepalive added for reconnects; cause of original Broken pipe remains unproved.

Existing debugging smoke workflow deliberately exits17 before opening Upterm. Both final jobs remain failure; successful native checks and successful provider cleanup do not relabel the workflow as passing.

remaining_unrun_or_separate.detail: No maintained owner was added or API changed; this diagnostic settles only requested native composition premises.

remaining_unrun_or_separate.gate: Real required Cargo/Bazel actions, all descendants and pressure/recovery
remaining_unrun_or_separate.detail: No compiler/linker/full-build suite or physical-pressure test was dispatched. The fixture covers one native child generation, not every possible nested tool tree.

remaining_unrun_or_separate.gate: Same-PID image replacement and unsupported event origins
remaining_unrun_or_separate.detail: CRT exec observed a new SPAWN process. Treat other event origins conservatively until actual authority exists; never close an old hook using root exit or an invented image-only execution barrier.

W2 successful readiness does not prove loader/heap/caller lock freedom. In particular parent independent review identified DLL_THREAD_ATTACH may execute under loader lock before GLib g_thread_proxy marks a new Frida thread ignored. This case was not tested, repaired or contradicted here.

remaining_unrun_or_separate.gate: Ordered allocation abort/retry and completion-free launch failure policy
remaining_unrun_or_separate.detail: Accepted queue/component receipts remain reusable. finish_completion_free_retry owns the separately assigned prerequisite diagnostic. No synthetic process outcome was introduced.
Empty copied event queues do not prove no lost notification. No new transport reliability or retransmission claim.

producer_report.supported_existing_sequence: Resource-free factory -> retain prepared exact Job root -> retain per-attempt manager -> retain root Member and AllocationHook before start -> accepted hook ready/child gating -> one-shot WindowsProcess.releaseRoot -> copied child event on queue thread -> exact Job Member and parent identity -> fresh installation/hook ready -> Member.requireLive -> manager.resume -> retain all owners while root may exit and child remains -> actual WindowsProcess whole-Job Result -> stop waits/grants -> hook close under actual barrier -> manager/member/process cleanup. Retire separately borrowed measurement Registration only after whole Job reaps, before process close/new attempt; reuse its accepted existing tests rather than repeating them. Copied callbacks never reenter JobQueue; drain immutable reports between queue operations.
producer_report.missing_operation: No missing existing operation observed for tested CreateProcess/CRT-SPAWN paths. No shared API changes are justified by these results. Image-only retirement authority remains unavailable/unproved for unobserved EXEC paths; do not invent it.
